text.en: The user now enters the stage with 0% MP and at the start of the stage, the [Myor's Blue Poison] effect is activated. Increases Attack by 5% times 10% of the user's current MP. Extending the Break or Wind Overload state, increases Critical Hit Rate by 50% and Critical Hit damage by 25% (Removed when [Unique Domain - White Flames Legacy] ends). When the user's attack hits, there is a 25% chance to activate Cadenza and Cadenza can be used when Dash is used while Cadenza is available (Cooldown: 6 second(s)). Using Grazioso activates the [Andantino] effect. Using Agitato puts the user in an [Aerial] state and transforms Andante to Andante Forte. Only the Basic Attack can be used when Andante Forte is active. Transforms Feroce to Feroce Sforzando for 5 second(s) after using Andante Stage 5 and increases damage by 100%. Activates an effect that increases Critical Hit damage by 1000% while using Pianissimo. In [Team Fight] mode, the user's damage dealt increases by 500%. [Myor's Blue Poison] Increases Defense Penetration by 10%. Increases damage dealt by 25%. Increases the user's Attack by 1.25% every 1 second(s) (stacks up to 30 times). Duration: Infinite [Andantino] Increases Andante damage by 100%. Using Andante additional restores 100% of the user's MP. Gains [Super Armor] while using Andante. Using Adante Stage 5 removes the Andantino effect. Duration: Infinite

text.en: The [Ascension] effect is activated when entering a stage. The Monarch of Shadows' Critical Hit Rate increases by 50% and their Critical Hit damage increases by 25% when the target's [Break] state and the [Dark] [Overload] duration are extended (Removed when [Unique Domain - Realm of the Dead] ends). Cannot recover Core Gauge Using Dual Fatality activates [Void Requiem] and creates 4 Shard(s). Using Dual Fatality transforms Mirage Blade and Abyssal Fang to Phantom Raid and Grim Edge, increasing their damage by 200%. Using Void Requiem 8 time(s) activates Dual Fatality, allowing the Monarch of Shadows to use it. Using Phantom Raid or Grim Edge creates 4 [Shard(s)]. Creating [Shards] activates the [Omen]. Using Void Requiem reduces the cooldown of Phantom Raid and Grim Edge by 0.1 second(s). Each time all skills, including the Core Attack, hit, they activate 1 [Silhouette(s)] (Cooldown: 2 second(s)). In [Team Fight] mode, the Monarch of Shadows' damage dealt increases by 500%. [Silhouette] A dagger that conceals its killing intent strikes from above. Applies an effect that deals Dark elemental damage equal to 234% of the Monarch of Shadows' Attack Counts as a Core Attack. [Ascension] Gains [Super Armor] while the effect is active. Increases damage dealt to Boss and Elite monsters by 50%. Increases Attack by 50%. Duration: Infinite [Omen] Increases Void Requiem damage by 50% Increases Sovereign Doom damage by 50%. Duration: 10 second(s)

text.en: Entering a stage activates the [Untamed Flame] effect, allowing the user to fight in the [Twin Blades Stance]. When the target's [Break] or Fire Overload duration are extended, the user's Critical Hit Rate increases by 50%, and their Critical Hit damage increases by 25% (Removed when [Unique Domain - Howling Fracture] ends). Using Vulpine Claw activates the [Double-Edged Spear Stance]. Using Fox Fang Snare activates the [Twin Blades Stance]. [Doubled-Edged Spear Stance] Basic Attack changes to Ravaging Claw. When Ravaging Claw hits, the user gains 1 instance of the [Elongated Claws] effect. If the [Twin Fangs] effect is active when this occurs, the number of [Twin Fangs] instances applied is reduced by 1. While in the [Doubled-Edged Spear Stance], Tear can be used if the user has 8 [Elongated Claws] instances applied. Using Tear consumes all the [Elongated Claws] instances and activates the [Tearing Claws] effect. [Twin Blades Stance] Basic Attack changes to Crimson Fang. When Crimson Fang hits, the user gains 1 instance of the [Twin Fangs] effect. If the [Elongated Claws] effect is active when this occurs, the number of [Elongated Claws] instances applied is reduced by 1. While in the [Twin Blades Stance], Bloodbound can be used if the user has 8 [Twin Fangs] instances applied. Using Bloodbound consumes all the [Twin Fangs] instances and activates the [Bloodbound Twin Fangs] effect. [Bloodbound] removes [Elongated Claws, Twin Fangs, Tearing Claws, and Bloodbound Twin Fangs] when the attack ends. In [Team Fight] Mode, damage dealt increases by 500% [Untamed Flame] Gains [Super Armor] while the effect is active. Increases damage dealt to Boss and Elite monsters by 50%. Increases Attack by 50%. Duration: Infinite [Elongated Claws] Increases Attack by 5% Increases Fire damage by 5%. Duration: Infinite (up to 8 instances) [Twin Fangs] Increases Attack by 5% Increases Critical Hit damage by 5%. Duration: Infinite (up to 8 instances) [Tearing Claws] Increases Attack by 50% Increases Fire damage by 50%. Increases Fire Overload damage by 30%. Increases Fox Fang Snare and Crimson Fang damage by 100%. Cannot obtain the [Elongated Claws] effect Duration: Infinite [Bloodbound Twin Fangs] Increases Attack by 50% Increases Critical Hit damage by 50%. Increases Defense Penetration by 20%. Increases Vulpine Claw and Ravaging Claw damage by 100%. Cannot obtain the [Twin Fangs] effect Duration: Infinite
